# Reviewers skip PR descriptions over 25 lines

## What happened

The review of 6 November looked at 30 merged pull requests. In the 11 whose description ran from 25 to 40 lines,
reviewers asked about something the description already said in 7; in the 19 under 25 lines, in 2. The missed line
was most often the one that said what was left out.

## What to do next time

Keep a PR description under 25 lines, and put what was left out in its first five lines.
